en.eNote: No day on this board carries a food log, so the chart plots the 2,000 kcal reference across all seven. Active burn averaged 374 kcal/day, from 3 kcal on the in-progress Friday to 611 kcal on Wednesday’s swim day.
en.bNote: Net exercise = Garmin active calories; standing BMR 2,414. No day on this board has a measured intake, so every bar uses the 2,000 kcal placeholder and the balance column is a reference, not a reading.
en.wNote: The bridge still holds the last measured day, Thursday Sep 3: 1,845 kcal in, 2,414 basal, 688 net exercise, −1,257 kcal balance.
en.i1t: Three lifts and two swims, 35,180 kg
en.i1: Five sessions, 4h 55m, 2,805 active kcal: front squat Saturday, pool swim Monday, hack squat Tuesday, pool swim Wednesday, barbell deadlift Thursday. Lifting tonnage was 35,180 kg against 36,720 kg in the seven days before; Sunday and the in-progress Friday are the days off.
en.i2: Wednesday’s 500 + 8×200 + 100 covered 2,200 m in 61 minutes for 684 active kcal, at 2:31 per 100 m with 26 strokes a minute. Average HR was 126 and the peak 156. The last time this set was swum, Sep 11, it went 2:32 — the pace held. 18.7 °C air high.
en.i3: Thursday’s deadlift session topped at 120 kg × 8 over three working sets, against 120 kg × 10 on Sep 17, and moved 8,784 kg over 17 sets in 56 minutes at 113 average HR. Other latest top sets: front squat 80 kg × 8 on Sep 19, hack squat 200 kg × 10 on Sep 22.
en.i4: Last night scored 74 on 5h 54m with 10 minutes awake, down from 78; HRV 38 against a 42.1 28-day baseline, RHR 54 against 52.8. Four of the last seven recorded nights landed under seven hours, 4.9 h short in total.
en.rec: Lifting tonnage over the last seven days is 35,180 kg against 36,720 kg in the seven before, with the 28-day chronic load at 37,147 kg a week — an ACWR of 0.95. The flag is the hack-squat top set: 180 kg × 12 on Sep 15 became 200 kg × 10 on Sep 22, an 11.1% load jump in seven days. Next session: front squat, 4 × 8 at 80 kg — the top set held on Sep 19. Carbohydrate is the lever: today is a rest day at 3 kcal active burn, so the 1,750 kcal / 111 g target applies — move the 101 g gap to the 212 g training-day target into tomorrow’s pre-squat meal.

hr.eNote: Nijedan dan na ovoj ploči nema zapis hrane, pa graf kroz svih sedam crta referentnih 2.000 kcal. Aktivna potrošnja prosječno je 374 kcal/dan, od 3 kcal u petak u tijeku do 611 kcal u srijedu, na dan plivanja.
hr.bNote: Neto trening = Garmin aktivne kalorije; standardni BMR 2.414. Nijedan dan na ovoj ploči nema izmjeren unos, pa svaki stupac koristi rezervnih 2.000 kcal, a stupac bilance je referenca, a ne očitanje.
hr.wNote: Most još drži zadnji izmjereni dan, četvrtak 3.9.: 1.845 kcal unosa, 2.414 bazal, 688 neto treninga, −1.257 kcal bilance.
hr.i1t: Tri dizanja i dva plivanja, 35.180 kg
hr.i1: Pet treninga, 4h 55m, 2.805 aktivnih kcal: prednji čučanj u subotu, plivanje u bazenu u ponedjeljak, hack čučanj u utorak, plivanje u bazenu u srijedu, mrtvo dizanje sa šipkom u četvrtak. Tonaža dizanja bila je 35.180 kg naspram 36.720 kg u sedam dana prije; nedjelja i petak u tijeku su dani odmora.
hr.i2: Srijedin set 500 + 8×200 + 100 prešao je 2.200 m u 61 minuti uz 684 aktivnih kcal, tempom 2:31 na 100 m i 26 zaveslaja u minuti. Prosječni puls bio je 126, a vrh 156. Zadnji put kad je taj set plivan, 11.9., tempo je bio 2:32 — dakle zadržan. Najviša temperatura zraka 18,7 °C.
hr.i3: Četvrtkov trening mrtvog dizanja vrhunac je imao na 120 kg × 8 kroz tri radne serije, naspram 120 kg × 10 dana 17.9., i pomaknuo je 8.784 kg kroz 17 serija u 56 minuta uz prosječni puls 113. Ostale zadnje najteže serije: prednji čučanj 80 kg × 8 dana 19.9., hack čučanj 200 kg × 10 dana 22.9.
hr.i4: Sinoć je ocjena bila 74 uz 5h 54m i 10 minuta budnosti, dolje sa 78; HRV 38 naspram 28-dnevne osnove od 42,1, RHR 54 naspram 52,8. Četiri od zadnjih sedam zabilježenih noći bile su ispod sedam sati, ukupno 4,9 h manjka.
hr.rec: Tonaža dizanja u zadnjih sedam dana iznosi 35.180 kg naspram 36.720 kg u sedam dana prije, a 28-dnevno kronično opterećenje je 37.147 kg tjedno — ACWR 0,95. Upozorenje je najteža serija hack čučnja: 180 kg × 12 dana 15.9. postalo je 200 kg × 10 dana 22.9., skok opterećenja od 11,1 % u sedam dana. Sljedeći trening: prednji čučanj, 4 × 8 uz 80 kg — najteža serija zadržana 19.9. Poluga su ugljikohidrati: danas je dan odmora uz 3 kcal aktivne potrošnje, pa vrijedi cilj od 1.750 kcal / 111 g — razliku od 101 g do cilja za dan treninga od 212 g prebaci u sutrašnji obrok prije čučnja.
